description: Expo React Native fitness intelligence app with Stitch design system, procedural 3D spheres, Reanimated animations, and Gemini AI coaching.

home.description: Main dashboard with date navigation, 3D longevity sphere hero, daily directive, pillar cards, correlation insights, and activity timeline.
keyComponents: PillarCard ×3 (Readiness/Resilience/Longevity with scores and trend arrows)
metrics: RHR, HRV, HRV zScore, RHR zScore
weeklyPlan (recommended strain, workout type, bedtime, protocols)
bodySystems (HRV status, HR status, SpO₂, temperature)

health.description: Health deep-dive with 4 views: default overview + 3 drilldown views (Readiness/Resilience/Longevity) matching Stitch reference designs.

default.label: Health Deep-Dive (Default)
default.description: Overview with biological age slider, vital stats grid, strain gauge, recovery trend, activities list.
metrics: runningDynamics (vertical oscillation, ground contact, power, cadence)

readiness.label: Readiness Drill-down
readiness.description: Teal morph sphere with breathe animation, RHR vs average delta, HRV area gradient, recovery history bars, sleep duration vs need, ANS balance spectrum.
features: Teal procedural sphere (#0F766E→#2DD4BF→#042F2E) with morph + breathe animations
PRIME ZONE label with recovery score
RHR module: current bpm + delta vs average (↑/↓ X bpm vs avg) + sparkline
HRV module: current ms + area gradient fill + sparkline
Recovery History: W/F/S teal bars with glow shadow on today
Sleep Duration vs Need: horizontal layout (actual vs need), debt indicator, progress bar
ANS Balance: gradient bar (error→white→tertiary), 5 scale markers, midpoint marker (white/50), indicator dot at ~80% parasympathetic, description panel

resilience.label: Resilience Drill-down
resilience.description: Purple organic orb sphere, immunity/cardiac stress cards, CNS load gradient gauge, 7-day resilience trend, body details (movement/environment/cardio).
features: Purple procedural orb (#C084FC→#A855F7→#7E22CE) with morph + breathe animations
72 SCORE with 'ROBUST' status and description text
Immunity Risk card: LOW/MODERATE/HIGH with mini progress bar (25%)
Cardiac Stress card: HR RECOVERY SPEED → bpm/min + ECG sparkline mockup
CNS Load: gradient gauge bar (purple→red), score/100 display, RECOVERED/FATIGUED labels
CNS sub-metrics: audio noise (dB), daylight deficit (min), HRV suppression (%)
7-Day Resilience Trend: bars with glow-filter on today (purple shadow + full opacity), others at 35%
Body Details: Movement (asymmetry/stability/speed), Environment (sunlight/standing/exercise), Cardio (VO2 Max/breathing)

longevity.label: Longevity Drill-down
longevity.description: LongevitySphere hero, bio vs chrono age slider, VO2 Max area chart, gait symmetry ring chart, stability index bars, AI protocol adherence checklist.
features: LongevitySphere component (0.82x pace, 'Rejuvenating' label)
Bio vs Chrono Age slider: bio fill (cyan glow), chrono marker (white dot)
VO2 Max Trend: area chart with gradient fill + sparkline + current value dot + 'Superior'/'Excellent' badge
Gait Symmetry: ring chart (68px circle, colored arc, percentage centered)
Stability Index: 'HIGH' label with 5-bar visualization (varied heights, glow on peak)
AI Protocol Adherence: 3-item checklist (Zone 2 Cardio, NMN Stack, Hyperbaric Oxygen) with check circles + strikethrough
metrics: vo2Max (mL/kg/min, trend sparkline, fitness rating badge)

coach.description: AI Health Assistant with Gemini-powered chat, biometric context widget, quick suggestions, Kilo Insights, and RAG-powered knowledge retrieval.
features: Chat with Gemini AI coach (streaming responses)
BiometricsContextWidget (recovery score, strain score, zone indicator)
Quick suggestion chips (Recovery, CNS, Running Form, Injury Risk, Sleep Debt, HRV Trend)
Kilo Insights panel after first AI response (Metabolic Efficiency sparkline, Recovery Forecast countdown)
Suggestive Analysis chips (Sleep Consistency, Overtraining Risk, etc.)
VisionCapture for meal/workout photo analysis
RAG knowledge base integration for contextual responses
Coach typing indicator, message bubbles with biometric context

profile.description: Athlete profile with identity panel, all-time records, 7-day strain/recovery chart, activity summary, and navigation to weekly/monthly reports + export tools.
features: Athlete identity panel (avatar, name, specialty tag: ENDURANCE SPECIALIST)
Stats row (total workouts, active days / 90-day target)
All-time highs: MAX STRAIN + DEEP SLEEP RECORD
7-Day Strain/Recovery bar chart
Activity summary (workout breakdown by type)
Weekly Report / Monthly Report navigation buttons
Export Tools (CSV, JSON, health report)

sleepDrilldown.description: Detailed sleep architecture view for a selected date with 7-night history and recovery context.
metrics: 7-night sleep history (duration, REM, deep, core breakdown)

weeklySummary.description: Week-level aggregation with recovery zone distribution, sleep phase trend, CNS/daylight chart, strain bar chart, and weekly insights.
metrics: weekStats (avg/stDev recovery, avg strain, green/yellow/red zone count, avg sleep)
cnsDaylightChart (7-day paired bars: CNS stress + daylight)
strainBarChart (7-day bars with stats: avg, max, total)

monthlySummary.description: Month-level aggregation with calendar heatmap, VO2 Max trend, bio age delta, training/recovery balance, habit adherence, and autonomic balance.
metrics: vo2MaxTrend (month VO2 values, linear regression trendline)
bioAgeDelta (last 4 weeks: biological age vs pace of aging bars)
trainingRecoveryBalance (7-day buckets: strain vs recovery paired bars)
habitAdherence (top 3 habits with completion % and mini bar)

editProfile.description: Edit athlete profile: name, chronological age, specialty, body metrics, health goals, and preferences.
metrics: healthGoals (performance, longevity, body comp, sleep, stress)

algorithmEngine.description: Heuristic synthesis engine produces pillar scores and recommendations from raw biometric data.
modules: recovery.ts — recoveryScore, recoveryZone, HRV ratio, RHR delta, strainScore, strainLevel
runningForm.ts — runningDynamics (vertical oscillation, ground contact, power, cadence)
trendEngine.ts — 7d/14d/30d slopes, direction, volatility, acceleration, zScores
weeklyPlanner.ts — 7-day training plan (strain targets, workout types, protocols)
habitImpact.ts — habit adherence tracking and impact scoring
